notes: The dual's shapes as data (NP_01 s2 canonical structure, s3.3 tiebreak ladder, s6 condition carry, s8 alternate formats). 'dressed' is the roster each side brings; 'segments' the slots; a roster shorter than the slots repeats (repeat_slots) and a fighter who re-enters carries stamina, guard and composure from the segment he left (condition_carries). sudden_death is the R6 Golden DROP at the bottom of the ladder. blind: no reveals. Exhibition 2v2 (simultaneous) is not a rotation format and is not here.
